data.topic: Refactor run-stories SKILL.md: extract procedural logic into Python/bash scripts, reduce SKILL.md to concise orchestration prompt
data.input_summary: Extract 640-line run-stories SKILL.md into callable scripts for procedural logic (worktree setup, conflict detection, merge gate, batch verification) while keeping orchestration decisions and agent coordination in the SKILL.md prompt.

decisions.area: State management between scripts and SKILL.md
decisions.choice: Separate run-state.db SQLite file (~/.claude/.claude/run-state.db). Scripts write transient execution state (resolved stories, execution groups, batch results, merge verdicts). SKILL.md reads via sqlite3. Cleaned up after each run completes.
decisions.reasoning: Survives context compaction and session crashes (portability). Keeps epics.db contract intact (ORCHESTRATION §4 — Claude writes only plan_file and state). Scripts own their own state without coordination with Gemini pm_* tools. No schema pollution of permanent data.

decisions.choice: Scripts return structured data blocks (pitfalls, learnings, write targets, gitignore warnings). SKILL.md assembles the full coder prompt with prose and context-specific nuance.
decisions.reasoning: LLM retains flexibility to inject session-specific context, model-specific warnings, and adapt tone. Scripts handle data retrieval, not prompt engineering.

decisions.choice: Python script classifies test output using pattern matching (compile error vs logic failure). Returns structured verdict JSON.
decisions.reasoning: Deterministic, testable, doesn't consume context tokens. Same heuristic as current SKILL.md but extractable and unit-testable.

decisions.choice: Move worktree creation to before agent launch (in main session or resolution subagent). Coder agents only verify they're on the correct branch.
decisions.reasoning: Eliminates duplicated bash in coder and test agent prompts. Reduces agent prompt complexity. Worktree creation is 100% deterministic — no LLM judgment needed.

decisions.choice: Keep inline in SKILL.md. Not extracted to scripts.
decisions.reasoning: Symbol-level conflict reclassification requires semantic judgment about whether two annotations targeting the same file are truly independent. This is the LLM's strength.

decisions.choice: build-verify and worktree-cleanup scripts shared between run-stories and merge-worktree skills.
decisions.reasoning: Both skills currently duplicate ~100 lines of build verification and worktree cleanup logic. Shared scripts eliminate drift between them.

constraints.value: bash/python scripts only. No new dependencies or build systems.
epics.db contract (ORCHESTRATION §4) must not be violated. Claude writes only plan_file and state via pm_update_story.
Agent tool invocations must stay in SKILL.md — scripts cannot launch Claude Code agents.
No changes to the worktree isolation model, Gemini/Claude dual-model architecture, or merge-worktree skill contract.
Auto-planning (pm_plan_story + plan-writing agents) stays in SKILL.md — requires MCP and Agent tool calls.
